settings.heading: Four origins, one country
settings.text:
Ethiopia is where coffee comes from — not as a marketing line, but as a matter of botany. Every arabica plant on earth traces back to these highlands, and the varietals still growing wild here have no names because no one ever needed to give them any.

We roast four origins in small batches and date every bag. Whole bean only — grind it when you brew it.

settings.name: Yirgacheffe
settings.notes: Jasmine, bergamot, lemon peel. Clean and tea-like.

settings.name: Harar
settings.notes: Blueberry, dried apricot, a winey depth. Heavy body.

settings.name: Sidama
settings.notes: Peach, brown sugar, black tea. Round and gentle.

settings.name: Guji
settings.notes: Strawberry, dark chocolate, something tropical behind it.
